My name is Jose. I am coming from Thiruvananthapuram. On July tenth, 2024, I came here and took the Covenant. Before taking the Covenant,
I was a person who really did not have much interest in Marian devotion. But right next to my parish church,
there is a beautiful little shrine in the name of the Holy Mother of God. A very lovely shrine. I never used to go there. I never used to pray there.
I was a person who would not even turn my head in that direction. But in my hand I would always have a holy Rosary. I would always pray it.
While being like that, when I was going through some personal problems, a big thought arose within me that I should come to Kreupasanam and take the Covenant.
But even then I had a doubt — is this Covenant the right way? Should I take this Covenant or should I not take it?
That big doubt was inside me. While being like that, I called Brother Paul, who conducts retreats in retreat centres.
While speaking to him and sharing my problems, he told me — you must go to Kreupasanam, you must take the Covenant.
Such a message is what God is inspiring in my heart — that is what Brother told me.
Then I became very happy. I decided that I should come to Kreupasanam and take the Covenant.
So on July tenth, I came here. I came here with a lot of joy. But when I reached here,
all my joy went away — because of the unbelievable crowd here and the tiredness of the journey. For me, if I do not eat at the correct time, I have migraine issues.
When even the beginning of that started, I was fully uneasy. Somehow I took the Covenant and went back home.
Especially, I did not get any godly experience. But as each day passed, I felt that big, big changes were happening in my life.
Especially in my prayer life, great changes happened. I used to earlier also spend a lot of time... I am a person who prays,
a person who reads the Bible, a person who prays the Rosary. But even in all this, I had a great lack of faith.
If I took one step toward God, I would go twenty steps backward. That was my faith.
But after the Covenant, a great change came in that. God is not far away — He is very close.
A strong realization began to grow within me that the Holy Mother of God is the greatest intercessor. With the Holy Mother and with Jesus,
like speaking openly to a friend or a mother, I received the great blessing and grace to pray with my heart opened like that.
While being like that, that same month July 30th,
this son, Rijo — he is my sister’s son. He had fever and went to a hospital in Thiruvananthapuram itself. But unfortunately,
because of the negligence of the nurses there, he was given the wrong medicine injection. Immediately he started vomiting, his pulse rate dropped,
his heartbeat dropped, he started having chest pain, and he reached a state of losing consciousness. Very quickly, they took him to Thiruvananthapuram SAT Medical College.
As soon as they took him, they directly put him on the ventilator because his condition was extremely serious.
At that time, when I received this news by phone,
the very first one I prayed to was the Holy Mother — “Mother, if You give him back his life, I will come here and testify,” saying that I directly went to the hospital.
When I went inside the hospital, my sister — his mother — came near me and said, “Just now the doctor came and told us — do not expect too much.
We are trying. You pray.” Then I told her one thing — “You should not be afraid of anything.
Nothing will happen to him. I have said to the Holy Mother that I will come here and testify,” saying that,
I came here. At that time, in my hand, I had the Covenant medal. I also had the Covenant oil.
They did not allow us to go near him. With every passing moment, his condition became extremely serious. His life had almost reached a state where it could be lost.
When the next day came, the doctors openly told us — now the chance of getting him back alive is very doubtful.
There is less than just 30% chance for that. With the help of this ventilator itself,
if you want to continue like this, you may continue — but we cannot say how many hours or how many days. Then the other option is ECMO treatment —
to keep his life going with the help of the ECMO machine — but even there, we cannot say how long or how many days.
Even if by any chance he recovers and returns, he may have to live the rest of his life paralyzed. That is only a possibility.
The actual truth is — he is going towards death. That is the truth. After that, they decided to continue ECMO treatment.
So they shifted him from the ventilator to the ICU. While shifting him to the ICU, they showed him
to all our relatives — because they themselves knew that this half-alive child would never return again. So his ECMO treatment started.
But there was no expected big improvement. Around that same time, Kerala’s leading newspapers reported his news — “Wrong medicine injected,
child’s condition extremely serious” — this news was reported by Kerala’s leading newspapers.
His news also began to appear on major television channels. Only after that, many people came to know about his situation. But around that time,
we were going through a very heavy emotional breakdown. The State Human Rights Commission directly took up the case. Police enquiry was going on.
Top officials were coming to the hospital. Media pressure on one side,
political pressure for taking advantage on another side — when all these came together, we were in a completely mentally broken condition. As St. Paul says, "outwardly battles, inwardly fear",
that was exactly our state. What everyone wanted was his story for the news. But what we wanted was his life.
At that time, a lot of people prayed for him — personally and in groups, many prayed for him. Around ten churches offered Holy Mass for him.
Without religious difference, without church difference, many people started praying for him.
Even during that time, even if a small improvement came, the situation never reached a point of overcoming the danger. Still the doctors kept saying one thing — you should not expect too much.
Anything can happen at any moment. Expect only that.
Then, in the month of August, on a Sunday — the fourth day— my paternal uncle’s son Jose and his wife Ranjana chechi came there.
They gave me the Covenant articles.
After giving the Covenant articles, they told me — “This oil must be applied on him.” But even before that, when I was coming to see him,
I already had the Covenant oil and the Covenant medal with me. But that day I could not reach near him. However, with this Covenant oil and the Covenant articles,
when I was going up to the ICU on the third floor, I felt as if someone was speaking in my heart,
“Earlier, you tried to reach him first with the Covenant articles, but you could not.
Now, here, through the intercession of the Holy Mother, these Covenant articles have again reached into your hands. Somehow, you must take them near him.
The rest — Mother will take care of.” These words — “Mother will take care of the rest” — felt as if someone was speaking inside me.
When I reached in front of the ICU, my elder sister Lizy was there. I gave her the Covenant articles and said — “This must somehow reach near him.”
But from 1 PM in the afternoon until 7:30 PM in the night, even after sitting there the whole time,
no suitable chance came to take these Covenant articles near him. At that moment, Sebastian sir — the one who teaches my son catechism — came there.
He came with the Rosary he had blessed and prayed. And then, for all of us, the intention was the same — somehow these Covenant articles,
must be taken near him. Suddenly, the atmosphere there changed. Through the grandmother of a child who was admitted there,
we got introduced to a nurse. She agreed to take the Covenant articles near him and place them there. We dipped the Covenant medal in the Holy oil,
and I, my elder sister, and Sebastian sir placed our hands on it and prayed — because we three were the ones who had taken the Covenant.
While we prayed, saying the Creed of Faith and praising, suddenly I felt a strong vibration.
I felt as if I was rising upward. After that, they placed the Covenant articles near him.
I scattered the Covenant salt in front of the ICU while saying the Creed of Faith. I took the Covenant oil and with that oil, on the ICU doors, windows, and walls,
I traced the sign of the Cross. While tracing the sign of the Cross, I still remember saying one thing — “In the name of the Father,
and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit — by the power of the Name of Jesus,
let not even a single angel of death enter inside this ICU anymore.” Saying that, I prayed the Creed of Faith.
When the prayer ended, I felt as though a huge weight was lifted off from within me — because until that day,
we had been going through so much tension. That night, I slept peacefully. The next day morning, his father came to me and said,
“I had called the Church of the Miraculous Mother in Thiruvananthapuram for prayer support.
But one of the brothers there told me that there is nothing to be afraid of about the child — the Holy Mother has a great presence near him,” he told me.
When I heard that, I told him everything that had happened the previous day — how the Covenant articles were taken and placed near him.
That is when he understood everything. He received a great faith. Later, he also came here and took the Covenant. While being like that,
that very same day in the evening — it was the day when the ECMO machine support was going to be removed.
When I went home that day, I had a lot of anxiety inside me — I had anxiety about what would happen in the hospital.
When I reached home, there was a Kreupasanam newsletter there — which I had received sometime earlier in the hospital — but I had never opened it.
I took it and read it. I only opened and read the Editorial written by Rev. Fr. Joseph. While reading it,
suddenly Revelation chapter 21 verse 4 attracted me. The verse was like this — “He will wipe every tear from their eyes.
There will be no more death, no more sorrow, no more crying, no more pain. All the old things have passed away.”
I read that verse again and again — and as I kept reading,
great joy began to fill inside me. I immediately went back to the hospital. On the way, one of our locals asked me,
“How is the child now?” I said — “There is nothing wrong. He is perfectly fine.” But how I said that,
I still don’t know. It is by the power of that one Scripture verse that I said it. Because even the doctors had not said anything like that until that very moment.
When I reached the hospital, his father came toward me with both hands outstretched and said — “Jose, the child is absolutely fine.
The machine support has been removed. He has now started breathing properly.” At that moment, I did not know what to do — I could not understand what miracle had happened there.
I did not understand whether I should cry or laugh — I just stood there.
This son — who had been going towards death — was returned to us by God the Father through the intercession of the Holy Mother. Today, before you, before this Holy Altar,
he stands as a witness. Only after this, did we come to know some more things — that while he was in ICU,
two times his ECG monitor stopped, which means he actually died.
The news inside the hospital was that he died — but nobody told us. Nobody informed us.
Around the very same time, we brought the Covenant articles near him. After that, one doctor told us a truth — from the exact moment you placed those articles — that is,
the Covenant articles — from that moment onward, his condition began to change, he began to return to life.
He started breathing strongly. We offer great thanks to the Holy Mother and to Jesus who gave all these graces.
The doctors had said he would be in the ICU for about two weeks — but before even two weeks passed, he was discharged and came home.
He was told to take total rest for around six months — but before six months were complete,
he began going to school. He began going to church. So many blessings were given to us —
his very life was given back to us — we give great thanks to the Holy Mother and to Jesus.
The Gospel of Saint Mark, chapter nine, verses 24 and 25 — “Immediately the father of the child cried out and said, ‘I believe; help my unbelief.’
When Jesus saw that the crowd came running together, He rebuked the unclean spirit — ‘You deaf and dumb spirit, I command you,
come out of him and never enter him again.’” What we have heard is a powerful testimony of faith from Brother Jose — a strong testimony.
A great change that happened in Brother Jose’s life — through the healing of a child,
Jose received a great healing in faith — that is what we understand. The Mother is present everywhere — but here,
many come with questions — “Why should we pray here?” But when a danger came to his sister’s child, he came here with a great
surrender — believing that only the Holy Mother in this sanctuary will intercede and help. And when he prayed, we heard about the great miracle that happened for this child.
Through the Mother of time shortening, a sign of healing — Jesus brought into Jose’s life an experience of the Precious Blood,
an experience of salvation. Because of medication — by a slight change in medicine — the child went into a dangerous condition — from which he was saved,
and that is what we have heard.
Inside the ICU itself, the news spread everywhere that the child had died. Meanwhile, media, politics,
and cries for justice were rising — but for them (the family), it was tears and prayer for the life of the child. Even after all this, Jose
never lost his faith — because he believed strongly in the nearness of the Holy Mother — that if the covenant articles somehow reached near the child, his life would return.
That was the great faith he had — and that became the turning point. When the nearness of the Mother reached near the child’s bedside,
immediately the child began to breathe well and began to return to life. Just as he shared, in the Book of Revelation — chapter 21,
verse 4 says — “I will wipe every tear from your eyes.” All of our tears are collected by God in His bottle.
When He sees that, God remembers us and renews His Covenant again and again — bringing us into healing, peace,
and love. What we are hearing now is a great testimony. When we are in Covenant, for every matter we receive immediate solutions — that is what this testimony makes us understand.
Likewise, a friendship that was lost, a friend that went away — through this great life of the Covenant,
he was able to restore it. Any relationship built on God’s love — that will continue forever.
Whether it is doubt or any issue, nothing and no one can separate us from God’s love,
from the love of Christ. May God’s love remain in us — may that surrender to the Holy Mother always remain with us — and may this testimony support and strengthen our life.
Let us place this testimony along with prayers for all children in the ICU and all children receiving medical treatment —
let us pray — and give a good applause to Jesus and the Holy Mother for the testimony of Jose and the child — and offer the testimony.
Extraordinary divine experiences can become yours too.
